full_judgment: 8. This decision is an authority for the proposition that the orders passed at both the stages are judicial orders. The District Controller as we have mentioned took a different view of the matter but did not give his reasons. It is true that the punishing authority is not bound by the report of the enquiry officer but as it has been just stated that the report of enquiry officer is to be treated as a judicial order, reversal of such decision is permissible by the punishing authority provided the reasons are given.
